exam: Assam Police Constable Combined Written Test (CWT-2025) Paper-II
paper: Paper-II (GK, Current Affairs, Maths, English, Reasoning, Assam GK) - Booklet Code A
board: State Level Police Recruitment Board (SLPRB), Assam

questions.q: Who received the Green Oscar (Whitley Gold Award), 2024?
questions.e: Assamese wildlife biologist Dr. Purnima Devi Barman, known for saving the greater adjutant stork, won the 2024 Whitley Gold Award.

questions.q: Which organization released the Child Nutrition Report, 2024?
questions.e: UNICEF published the Child Nutrition Report 2024 on child food poverty.

questions.q: In the World Press Freedom Index, 2024, what is India’s rank among 180 countries?
questions.e: India ranked 159 out of 180 countries in the RSF World Press Freedom Index 2024.

questions.q: When is ‘National Cancer Awareness Day’ observed?
questions.e: National Cancer Awareness Day is observed on 7 November, the birth anniversary of Marie Curie.

questions.q: In which of the following districts is the ‘Jonbeel Mela’ held every year?
questions.e: Jonbeel Mela, famous for barter trade, is held every year at Jagiroad in Morigaon district.

questions.q: ‘Silpi Divas’ is celebrated on
questions.e: Silpi Divas is observed on 17 January, the death anniversary of Rupkonwar Jyoti Prasad Agarwala.

questions.q: Where is the ‘Assam State Museum’ located?
questions.e: The Assam State Museum is located in Guwahati, near Dighalipukhuri.

questions.q: ASTC stands for
questions.e: ASTC is the Assam State Transport Corporation, the state's public bus operator.

questions.q: Which of the following is not an inert gas?
questions.e: Argon, helium and neon are noble (inert) gases; nitrogen is a reactive group 15 element.

questions.q: The Peasant Uprising of Assam in 1894 took place at
questions.e: The 1894 peasant uprising against increased land revenue saw British firing on farmers at Patharughat (Darrang).

questions.q: Who won the best player award in the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup, 2024?
questions.e: Jasprit Bumrah was named Player of the Tournament at the 2024 ICC Men's T20 World Cup.

questions.q: Where will the 2034 FIFA World Cup be held?
questions.e: FIFA confirmed Saudi Arabia as host of the 2034 FIFA World Cup.

questions.q: Standard Missile–6 (SM–6) was developed by which country?
questions.e: The Standard Missile-6 (SM-6) was developed by Raytheon for the US Navy.

questions.q: PM-SURAJ Portal is implemented by which Ministry?
o: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
questions.e: PM-SURAJ portal, for credit support to disadvantaged sections, is run by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

questions.q: Which player won the Orange Cap in IPL, 2024?
questions.e: Virat Kohli won the Orange Cap in IPL 2024 with 741 runs.

questions.q: Which sector has received the highest allocation in the Budget for 2025–2026?
questions.e: Defence received the largest sectoral allocation in the Union Budget 2025-26.

questions.q: Who is the current External Affairs Minister of India?
questions.e: Dr. S. Jaishankar has been India's External Affairs Minister since 2019.

questions.q: Consider the following statements regarding the Z-Morh Tunnel (Sonamarg Tunnel) : 1. It is a part of Zojila Tunnel Project. 2. The 6.5 km long tunnel connects Gagangir and Sonamarg region in Jammu and Kashmir. 3. The project comes under the supervision of the National Highways Authority of India. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: The 6.5 km Z-Morh tunnel links Gagangir and Sonamarg as part of the Zojila tunnel project; it was built under NHIDCL, not NHAI.

questions.q: Which of the following is the first AI city in India?
questions.e: Lucknow was promoted as India's first AI city under the IndiaAI mission.

questions.q: Which tech company has launched ‘Copilot+’ PCs with AI-enhanced functionality and a unique ‘Recall’ feature?
questions.e: Microsoft launched Copilot+ PCs in 2024 with the AI 'Recall' feature.

questions.q: What is the minimum number to be added to 1289 so that it becomes a perfect square?
questions.e: 36² = 1296, so 1296 − 1289 = 7 must be added.

questions.q: The base and height of a parallelogram are 5 cm and 3 cm respectively. Find the area of the parallelogram.
questions.e: Area of a parallelogram = base × height = 5 × 3 = 15 cm².

questions.q: In how many years will a sum of money be doubled itself at a simple interest of 10% p.a.?
questions.e: Doubling means interest equals principal: P = P × 10 × T / 100, so T = 10 years.

questions.q: A and B started a partnership business investing ₹10,000 and ₹6,400 respectively. After 5 months, A withdrew ₹3,000 and B added ₹600 to their investment. Being active partner, B gets 10% of the annual profit as salary. If the profit at the end of one year is ₹16,000, the share of profit of B will be
questions.e: Capital-months A = 99000, B = 81000 (11 : 9). B gets ₹1,600 salary plus 9/20 of ₹14,400 = ₹6,480, total ₹8,080.

questions.q: Find the median of the following numbers : 32, 32, 34, 35, 35, 38, 42
questions.e: For 7 ordered values the median is the 4th value, 35.

questions.q: The amount on compound interest of ₹100 for 2 years at the rate of 10% per annum is
If the HCF and LCM of p and q are r and s respectively, then the LCM of p, q, r and s is (p, q ∈ natural numbers)
questions.e: r divides both p and q, and s is a multiple of both, so the LCM of p, q, r, s is s.

questions.q: The sum of the odd consecutive numbers from 1 to 25 is
questions.e: Odd numbers 1 to 25 are 13 terms; their sum = 13² = 169.

questions.q: Which one of the following statements is not true?
o: Each even (positive) number is a natural number.
Each natural number is an even number.
questions.e: Natural numbers include odd numbers, so 'each natural number is even' is false.

questions.q: If the price of an article is ₹200 and the rebate on it is 10%, then the customer has to pay for this article
questions.e: 10% of 200 = 20, so the customer pays ₹180.

questions.q: If we divide ₹460 among 10 men, 16 women and 20 children equally, then the share of each one will be
questions.e: There are 10 + 16 + 20 = 46 persons; 460 / 46 = ₹10 each.

questions.q: If 2^(2x + 1) ÷ 4 = 8, then the value of x is
Two rational numbers a/b and c/d are equivalent if
questions.e: a/b = c/d exactly when a × d = b × c (cross-multiplication).

questions.q: If the base of a triangle is twice its altitude and the altitude is 2x unit, then the area of the triangle is
questions.e: Altitude 2x, base 4x; area = ½ × 4x × 2x = 4x² sq. units.

questions.q: Which of the following cannot be the measures of three sides of a triangle?
questions.e: 10 + 8 = 18 < 20, so 10, 20, 8 cannot form a triangle.

questions.q: “The sum of two consecutive odd numbers is 48.” This statement can be expressed in equation as
questions.e: Consecutive odd numbers differ by 2, so x + (x + 2) = 48.

questions.q: What is the distance between the x-axis and the line y + 2 = 0 ?
questions.e: y + 2 = 0 is the line y = −2, which is 2 units from the x-axis.

questions.q: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank in the following sentence : “Can you tell me _____ the truth?”
o: that why did you not speak
questions.e: In an embedded (indirect) question the subject comes before the verb: 'why you did not speak'.

questions.q: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank in the following sentence : “The train _____ before we reached the station.”
questions.e: The earlier of two past actions takes the past perfect: 'had left'.

questions.q: Choose the correct article to fill in the blank in the following sentence : “He is _____ MA in English.”
questions.e: 'MA' is pronounced 'em-ay', which begins with a vowel sound, so 'an' is used.

questions.q: Choose the correct question tag to complete the following sentence : “She is going there, _____”
questions.e: A positive statement with 'is' takes the negative tag 'isn't she?'.

questions.q: Find the incorrectly spelt word.
questions.e: The correct spelling is 'Conducive'.

questions.q: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank in the following sentence : “When I met Rajat in Mumbai, he _____ teaching English for four years.”
questions.e: An action continuing up to a point in the past uses the past perfect: 'had been teaching'.

questions.q: Fill in the blank of the following sentence with correct option : “Assam has tremendous potential _____ investors in service sector.”
questions.e: 'Potential for' someone is the correct collocation.

questions.q: Choose the correct passive form of the following sentence : “She is writing a letter.”
o: A letter is written by her.
A letter has been written by her.
A letter is being written by her.
A letter is writing by her.
questions.e: Present continuous passive is 'is being + past participle': 'A letter is being written by her.'

questions.q: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank in the following sentence : “She is _____ than any other girl in the class.”
questions.e: 'Than any other' needs the comparative degree: 'taller'.

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech of the following : She said, “I have finished the work.”
o: She said that she has finished the work.
She said that she would finish the work.
She said that she finished the work.
She said that she had finished the work.
questions.e: Present perfect in direct speech changes to past perfect: 'she had finished the work'.

questions.q: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank in the following sentence : “I asked him _____ so lazy.”
questions.e: A reported question uses 'why' + subject + verb, with backshift: 'why he was so lazy'.

questions.q: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank in the following sentence : “He always claims to be _____ everyone in his company.”
questions.e: 'Superior' is followed by 'to', not 'than'.

questions.q: Which of the following is incorrect ?
questions.e: Monkeys come in a 'troop' (swarm is used for bees/insects), so 'a swarm of monkeys' is incorrect.

questions.q: Which of the following words is closest in meaning to the word ‘abundant’ ?
questions.e: 'Abundant' means plentiful, i.e. 'ample'.

questions.q: The phrase ‘stem the tide’ means
questions.e: 'Stem the tide' means to stop or check the spread of something.

questions.q: The antonym of the word ‘callous’ is
questions.e: 'Callous' means insensitive and cruel; its opposite is 'sensitive'.

questions.q: Choose the odd word from the following.
questions.e: Agitated, aggressive and rowdy describe unruly behaviour; 'submissive' is the opposite.

questions.q: “O my Luve’s like a red, red rose” is an example of a
questions.e: The comparison uses 'like', which makes it a simile.

questions.q: What is the meaning of ‘cost an arm and leg’ ?
questions.e: 'Cost an arm and a leg' means to be very expensive.

questions.q: Choose the correct option to fill in the blank in the following sentence : “He was so hungry that he could _____ wait to wash his hands.”
questions.e: 'Could hardly wait' means he was too eager to wait.
The digits are reversed: 2×3×4 → 432, so 2×5×7 → 752.

questions.q: Fill in the blank : Doctor : Hospital : : Teacher : _____
questions.e: A doctor works in a hospital and a teacher works in a school.

questions.q: If in a certain code 5789 is written as GKPT and 2436 is written as ALUR, how will 24539 be written in that code?
questions.e: From the codes 2→A, 4→L, 5→G, 3→U, 9→T, so 24539 = ALGUT.

questions.q: Select the correct mathematical signs to balance the given expression : 6 * 4 * 9 * 15
questions.e: 6 × 4 − 9 = 15 balances the expression.

questions.q: If POLICE is coded as QOMIDE, then DACOIT will be coded as
questions.e: Letters in odd positions move +1 and even positions stay: D→E, A, C→D, O, I→J, T gives EADOJT.

questions.q: Ramya’s school starts at 10 o’clock in the morning, and after school she attends swimming course at 4 o’clock in the afternoon. By how much degree does the hour hand move during this time?
questions.e: From 10 to 4 is 6 hours; the hour hand moves 30° per hour, so 180°.

questions.q: Select the related letters from the following : ABC : UVW : : DEF : _____
questions.e: ABC is the 1st letter-group and UVW is shifted by 20 letters; DEF shifted by 20 gives XYZ.

questions.q: In the following series, select the missing number : 8, 24, 12, ?, 18, 54
The staple food crop of Assam is
questions.e: Rice is the staple food crop of Assam and covers most of its cropped area.

questions.q: The Kamakhya Temple is situated at
questions.e: The Kamakhya Temple stands on Nilachal Hill in Guwahati.

questions.q: Who was the last Swargadeo of Ahom Dynasty?
questions.e: Purandar Singha, the last Ahom ruler, was reinstated by the British in Upper Assam (1833-38).

questions.q: ‘Joy Daul’ was built in the memory of
questions.e: Rudra Singha built the Joy Dol (1698) in memory of his mother Joymoti Kunwari.

questions.q: Which of the following is not a district of Barak Valley?
questions.e: Barak Valley comprises Cachar, Hailakandi and Sribhumi (Karimganj); Morigaon is in the Brahmaputra Valley.

questions.q: Which of the following Kingdoms was finally annexed into the Ahom Kingdom by Swargadeo Rudra Singha?
questions.e: Rudra Singha defeated the Dimasa-Kachari king Tamradhwaj and brought the kingdom under Ahom suzerainty.

questions.q: Who was the first lady Chief Minister of Assam?
questions.e: Syeda Anwara Taimur (1980-81) was Assam's first woman Chief Minister.

questions.q: During whose reign was the Rang Ghar reconstructed using bricks and mortar?
questions.e: The Rang Ghar was rebuilt in brick and mortar during Pramatta Singha's reign (1744-51).

questions.q: Where is the ‘Assam Kayaking and Canoeing Training Centre’ located?
questions.e: The state Kayaking and Canoeing training centre is at Charan Beel in Morigaon.

questions.q: Where is the ‘Police Training College’ in Assam located?
questions.e: Assam Police Training College is located at Dergaon in Golaghat district.

questions.q: Where is the ‘Garampani Sanctuary’ located?
questions.e: Garampani Wildlife Sanctuary, known for hot springs, is near Diphu in Karbi Anglong.

questions.q: During whose reign did the Chinese pilgrim Hiuen Tsang visit Kamarupa?
questions.e: Hiuen Tsang visited Kamarupa around 642 CE during the reign of Bhaskaravarman.

questions.q: The Asian Development Bank recently approved what amount of loan to increase renewable energy capacity and improve energy security in the State of Assam?
questions.e: In 2024 the ADB approved a USD 434.25 million loan for Assam's renewable energy and power sector.

questions.q: Who among the following was hanged in the ‘Quit India Movement’ of 1942?
questions.e: Kushal Konwar was hanged in 1943 for the Sarupathar train sabotage during the Quit India Movement.

questions.q: Assam has international boundary with which two countries?
questions.e: Assam shares international borders with Bhutan and Bangladesh.

questions.q: The largest river island in India is situated in
questions.e: Majuli in the Brahmaputra, Assam, is India's largest river island.

questions.q: The only plateau in Assam is
questions.e: The Karbi (Karbi-Meghalaya) Plateau is the only plateau region of Assam.

questions.q: Fathiyyah-i-Ibriyyah of Shihab-ud-din Talish is an important source to know about
questions.e: Shihabuddin Talish's Fathiyyah-i-Ibriyyah chronicles Mir Jumla's 1662-63 expedition to Assam.

questions.q: Which of the following is the main pillar of Assam’s economy?
questions.e: Agriculture employs most of Assam's workforce and is the backbone of its economy.

questions.q: In which year was the fourth oil refinery of Assam started at Numaligarh?
questions.e: Numaligarh Refinery, Assam's fourth refinery, started operations in 1999.
